class_separation_check.note: Mean model_score by real true label, full 2024 test set -- checks whether v2 genuinely discriminates or just globally suppresses scores.
class_separation_check.verdict: v2 mean score is ~0.47-0.48 across every real dataset tested (2022 test, 2024 full, live 2026), almost independent of true label -- a globally-suppressed, barely-discriminative score, not genuine learned separation. The live over-flagging reduction (122->29) is explained by this same global suppression, not by the model learning to distinguish ordinary conditions from flood signal.
